title: Seven Russian drones cross Moldova, one tracked over Chișinău; Ukraine drops a Kerch bridge span; rung holds at 4
bottom_line: Spillover risk is unchanged at rung 4 (deadly or deliberate incident). That rung rests on October's deadly drone strike on a merchant ship off Romania. On Tuesday afternoon seven drones crossed Moldova during a Russian attack on Ukraine, Moldova's Defence Ministry said. Five crashed near villages and one was tracked toward Chișinău, and the country's airspace was closed. No one was hurt. Overnight Ukraine brought down a road span of the Kerch bridge, and Russia struck two Kyiv bridges. We have not yet logged the Moldovan case. The 30-day chance of a step up to rung 5 stays remote (5%).

ladder.rationale: The rung stays at 4 because of the deadly Khoryv strike off Constanța on 23 October. We log no new incident today. Nothing points to deliberate, sustained Russian action against a NATO or EU state, so a step to rung 5 stays remote (5%).

developments.headline: Seven drones cross Moldova during Russian attack; five crash near villages, one tracked toward Chișinău
developments.summary: Moldova's Defence Ministry recorded seven drones in its airspace between 15:45 and 18:10 local time on 17 November. Five fell near Cheltuitori, Pohorniceni, Pogrebeni, Cuhureștii de Jos and Băxani, and one disappeared near Leova. A Shahed-type drone was tracked toward Chișinău's Botanica sector. Airspace closed at 16:27, and six border crossings with Ukraine were shut. No injuries were reported.
developments.russian_framing: Reuters reports that Russia has rejected Moldova's accusations of drone incursions, saying Chișinău has provided no proof that the drones are Russian.

developments.headline: Ukraine brings down a road span of the Kerch bridge in second strike in a day
developments.summary: On the night of 16–17 November, Ukraine's SBU and other forces struck the Crimean bridge again; the SBU says one metal arch and a road span were destroyed. Aksyonov said road traffic was suspended. The Kyiv Independent reports a Flamingo missile was used, and Zelensky described it as the seventh phase of a weeks-long operation. Rail traffic later resumed.
developments.russian_framing: Peskov said Putin had been informed, a repair plan would be drawn up and the bridge would emerge stronger than before.

developments.headline: Russia claims a record 1,441 Ukrainian drones downed; Salavat petrochemical complex reported on fire
developments.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it hit the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat refinery in Bashkortostan, about 1,200 km from the border, overnight into 17 November. Bashkortostan's emergencies committee reported attacks on industrial zones in Ufa and Salavat. Russia's Defence Ministry claimed 1,441 drones downed, a second record in two nights.
developments.russian_framing: Bashkortostan's emergencies committee said more than 50 drones were repelled, all plants were working normally and there was "no critical damage".

developments.headline: Russian missiles hit both Kyiv Dnipro bridges; Moscow claims strikes on ports and cargo ships
developments.summary: Zelensky said four ballistic missiles targeted Kyiv's Southern Bridge and three the Northern Bridge. Both closed, two people died in Obolonskyi district, and eight regions had outages. Russia's Defence Ministry said it struck port and rail infrastructure and a dry-cargo ship at sea. Hungary suspended rail traffic with Ukraine for 17–18 November after a drone fell near Mukachevo station.
developments.russian_framing: Russia's Defence Ministry said it struck defence-industry, energy, transport and port targets and ships "used in the interests of the Ukrainian armed forces" (translated).

developments.headline: Ramstein meets at NATO; Zelensky proposes swap of partners' Patriot and IRIS-T interceptors
developments.summary: The Ukraine Defence Contact Group met at NATO headquarters on 17 November. Zelensky said Ukraine's priorities were Patriot and NASAMS missiles and more F-16s. He proposed that partners hand over Patriot and IRIS-T interceptors from existing stocks now, in exchange for new missiles Ukraine has ordered. Lithuania completed the deployment of two US rotational battalions.

categories.text: Ukraine dropped a Kerch bridge road span in a second strike within a day, halting road traffic (verification 5). Its General Staff claimed a hit on the Salavat refinery about 1,200 km away. Russia claimed a record 1,441 drones downed.

Russian ballistic missiles hit both Kyiv Dnipro bridges, and Moscow claimed hits on ports and a cargo ship. Romanian F-16s scrambled for 11 targets near the border overnight, with no violation recorded. Hungary suspended rail traffic with Ukraine after a drone fell near Mukachevo.

Putin arrived in China for APEC ahead of Thursday's planned meeting with Trump and Xi in Shenzhen. Kyiv says it proposed extending the Oleshky-style humanitarian operation to 10 more occupied settlements.

Seven drones crossed Moldova in about two and a half hours. Five crashed near villages, one about 11 km from Chișinău, and a Shahed-type drone was tracked toward the capital. We have not yet logged it because we could not open a Moldovan government statement.

Russia's Defence Ministry claimed a drone hit on a dry-cargo ship at sea. A ship damaged by a drone in Ukrainian waters in September ran aground at Vadu, Romania, after its anchor broke. Romanian authorities say it was not hit in Romanian waters, so we do not log it.

Lithuania's Chief of Defence Raimundas Vaikšnoras proposed physical barriers on vulnerable stretches of the Kaliningrad border, saying continuous patrols are costly. We found no new Russian exercise or build-up announced in the window.

Ramstein met at NATO, and Zelensky proposed swapping partners' Patriot and IRIS-T stocks for interceptors Ukraine has already ordered. Two US rotational battalions finished deploying to Lithuania. Estonia's foreign minister cited Bloomberg's report that US troop cuts in Europe will be smaller than feared.

strikes_new.target_name: Crimean (Kerch) bridge, road arch and span
strikes_new.damage: The SBU says one metal arch and a road span were destroyed. Reported footage appears to show the road arch collapsing into the strait; the rail arch stood.
strikes_new.effect: Aksyonov said road traffic across the bridge was suspended. Ferries carry vehicle traffic, and rail service later resumed.
strikes_new.summary: In the second strike on the bridge in a day, Ukraine hit it late on 16 November with missiles and drones. Aksyonov reported the attack and suspended road traffic. The Guardian reports the bridge was critically damaged. Peskov said a repair plan is being prepared.

judgement.text:
We assess the 30-day spillover picture is unchanged. The rung stays at 4, and no pathway moves. Airspace holds at four logged incidents in 30 days against a 90-day baseline of 14.3 a month. Part of that gap reflects cases, like today's, that we have not yet logged.

The Moldovan incursion is the day's most direct spillover. NewsMaker, citing the Defence Ministry, says seven drones crossed the country between 15:45 and 18:10 local time. Five came down near villages, including Cheltuitori, about 11 km from the capital, and a Shahed-type drone was tracked toward Chișinău's Botanica sector. Moldova closed its airspace at 16:27 and shut six crossings with Ukraine. Sandu said Moldova lacks the means to defend itself against drones. We do not log the incursion today because we could not open a Moldovan government statement. That is the standard we applied to earlier cases, and we expect to log it at rung 3 once we can. We assess that Russian Gerans routed over Moldova toward Odesa oblast are the likeliest explanation (likely, 65%). Five crashes near villages in one evening make a first injury in Moldova more plausible, so we raise F-2026-008 to 60%. Moldova stays at its floor of 3.

The Kerch bridge strike matters for Europe mainly through Moscow's likely response. Aksyonov said road traffic was suspended after the second attack in a day, and Peskov promised repairs. That same day, Russia's Defence Ministry said it struck Ukrainian ports and a cargo ship, and Russian missiles hit both Kyiv bridges. We assess that retaliation will concentrate on Odesa, the Danube ports and shipping. That keeps stray-drone and ship-strike risk to Romania and Moldova high over the coming weeks, and we hold maritime at likely (70%).

On the ceasefire paradox, Putin arrived in China ahead of Thursday's planned meeting with Trump and Xi. A deal there that sidelines Europe could cut near-term drone and ship risk while leaving the medium-term pressure on the eastern flank that A5 expects.
judgement.change_my_mind: A Moldovan or Romanian statement that drones over Moldova flew deliberate patterns over Chișinău or state facilities, rather than transit routes to Odesa, would point to intimidation rather than spillover. So would casualties, or repeat overflights of the capital on nights without strikes on southern Ukraine.

competing_explanations.subject: Drones over Moldova and toward Chișinău, 17 November

hypotheses.label: Routing spillover from strikes on Odesa oblast
hypotheses.assessment: The drones entered from Odesa oblast during a mass attack, and their crashes cluster along known transit routes. Moldova lacks the air defence to stop them, so routing through its airspace costs Russia little.

hypotheses.label: Deliberate intimidation of Moldova
hypotheses.assessment: A drone tracked toward the capital and seven entries in one evening could be meant to pressure Chișinău, but we have no statement saying the flight paths were unusual.

forecasts_new.question: Will Moldova's Ministry of Defence report drones entering Moldovan airspace on at least three separate days between 18 November and 17 December 2026?
forecasts_new.resolution_criteria: Yes if Moldova's Ministry of Defence or National Army reports unauthorised drone entries into Moldovan airspace on at least three distinct calendar dates between 18 November and 17 December 2026.
forecasts_new.base_rate_note: Moldova reported a record 19 violations in October. November drone entries came on about three days to the 17th (4, 12 and 17 November). Raised slightly for likely Russian retaliation on Odesa after Kerch.

forecast_updates.note: Moldova's Defence Ministry recorded seven drones on 17 November, which brings the November count close to 10, with 13 days remaining.
Five drones crashed near Moldovan villages on 17 November, one about 11 km from Chișinău; no injuries yet.
Russia's Foreign Ministry says Putin has arrived in China for APEC; the trilateral meeting is planned for Thursday in Shenzhen.

taiwan: The most direct effect is on interceptor supply. Zelensky asked partners to hand Ukraine Patriot and IRIS-T interceptors from existing stocks now, in exchange for missiles Ukraine has ordered. Any such swap would reshuffle delivery queues for the same PAC-3 production lines that fill Taiwan's orders. The size depends on Ramstein pledges, which are not yet published. Second, Ukraine's weeks-long campaign against radars and air defence before dropping a Kerch bridge span is a lesson in how a defended fixed crossing can be cut. It argues for dispersing Taiwan's key logistics nodes and layering their air defence. Third, Putin is in China ahead of Thursday's planned meeting with Trump and Xi in Shenzhen. Any US–Russia deal struck in Beijing's presence would tell China how far Washington will trade European security interests for great-power bargains.
